translations.web: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
translations.bsb: We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.
translations.kjv: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.
translations.asv: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is from God; that we might know the things that were freely given to us of God.
